notes.title: Thy Sword gets update! New content and features.
notes.notes:
Hello swordslingers and indie lovers!

We're happy to announce an update for Thy Sword.
New content and features have been added along with various fixes. Some new equipment and weapons are coming and also some functional stuff
that makes the game even more enjoyable. We hope you'll enjoy the content and we appreciate all the support from you guys.

New Achievements: 
- Ring the bell

New Items:
- Moonstone
- Bow of Fire

New Features:
- Gamepad vibration can be disabled
- Global sound volume can be changed

Visit gamephase.net for more info.

/Team GamePhase
